summary.text: Joseph Perrotta is the Republican candidate for the North Carolina House of Representatives, District 60, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Democrat Amanda Cook.
A business owner and president, he also ran for the same seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Perrotta was born in Bristol, Connecticut, and earned a high school diploma from Southwest Guilford High School.
He attended the University of Illinois Springfield and earned two associate degrees from Guilford Technical Community College, one in 2010 and another in 2025.
His career experience includes being a business owner and president.
Perrotta was the Republican candidate for North Carolina House District 60 in 2024, when incumbent Democrat Cecil Brockman defeated him, 63.2 percent to 36.8 percent.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, he said the district needs change and named affordability, AI data centers and public safety as key messages.

He said he supports limiting how often local commissioners can reassess and increase property taxes, supports a pause of the gas tax, and favors evaluating each data center separately so that electricity and water costs are not passed on to residents.
He also named healthcare costs and veterans' assistance as policy areas he cares about.
